collection.title: VW Caddy/Caddy Maxi Van (Split Rear Door) 2007 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Caddy 2007 to 2014 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, we also offer a rear blade for this Caddy, this can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Blades tab below.
